items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
items.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

items.title: US inflation jumps to 3.8% as energy costs surge from Iran war
items.description: The key measure of US inflation rose in April to its highest level since May 2023 as consumers feel the impact of the Iran war.

items.title: Uganda's president sworn in for record seventh term
items.description: Yoweri Museveni, 81, won disputed elections in January to extend his 40-year rule.

items.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
items.description: The situation could still change and there might be more confirmed cases, warns the head of the World Health Organization.

items.title: EU needs to delay social media access for children - von der Leyen
items.description: She told an EU summit that an expert panel was due to come up with steps on how to protect minors online by July.

items.title: Canvas hack: Company pays criminals to delete students' stolen data
items.description: The company behind Canvas says it has "reached an agreement" with the hackers who disrupted thousands of colleges and universities.

items.title: Snack giant switches to black and white packaging as Iran war hits ink supplies
items.description: The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz has severely disrupted global supplies of energy and petrochemicals.

items.title: Texas accuses Netflix of spying on users, including children
items.description: The lawsuit comes amid increased scrutiny over platform features like auto-play that deliver endless content to users.

items.title: France seeks to move beyond colonial ties by meeting African leaders in Kenya
items.description: In a first since these meetings started in the 1970s, this move reflects a change in France's thinking.

items.title: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why
items.description: There are calls to investigate the 16 March airstrike - which the UN says likely killed more - as a war crime.

items.title: How the Trump-Xi summit could set superpower relations for many years to come
items.description: Trump's whirlwind visit to China is the most significant for years - but will it bear fruit?

items.title: Ex-Philippine leader Duterte's drug war enforcer escapes ICC arrest
items.description: Senator Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa, a former national police chief, has sought refuge in the senate.
